Title: Standard user signs in
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{STANDARD_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type {{USER_PASSWORD}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
[WAIT] Wait for the Products page
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] No uncaught errors
[NETWORK] No 4xx/5xx on same-origin requests
[STORAGE] A session cookie is set

Title: Locked-out user is rejected
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{LOCKED_OUT_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type {{USER_PASSWORD}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
Assertions:
[DOM] Error banner visible
[TEXT] Error says the user has been locked out
[URL] Still on the login page

Title: Empty username
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Click 'Login' with both fields empty

Title: Empty password
Failure_Signals: No error; signs in without password

Title: Wrong password
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{STANDARD_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type wrong_password_{{timestamp}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
Assertions:
[TEXT] Error says username and password do not match
[URL] Still on the login page
[DOM] The typed password is not shown in the error

Title: Error banner can be dismissed
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Click 'Login' with both fields empty
[ACT] Click the error banner's close (X) button
Assertions:
[DOM] Error banner disappears
[DOM] Inputs no longer highlighted as invalid

Title: Protected pages require login
Preconditions: Fresh isolated browser, not signed in
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/inventory.html
[ASSERT] Note URL and error
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/cart.html
[ASSERT] Note URL and error
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/checkout-step-one.html
[ASSERT] Note URL and error
Assertions:
[URL] Every attempt lands on the login page
[TEXT] Each error names the page that was requested

Title: Slow user sign-in time
Steps:
[NOTE] Record the time just before clicking Login
[NAV] Navigate to {{FRONT_URL}}/
[ACT] Type {{PERFORMANCE_GLITCH_USER}} into 'Username'
[ACT] Type {{USER_PASSWORD}} into 'Password'
[ACT] Click 'Login'
[WAIT] Wait for the Products page
Assertions: [STATE] Measured click-to-Products time is under 3 seconds (record the number either way)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[PERF] Record the time to Products page
[CONSOLE] No uncaught errors
Failure_Signals: Sign-in takes >3s (expected for this demo user — report as FAIL with timing)
